model.summary: Model favors DEN by 5.6 points (67% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (DEN +4.4), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (DEN +1.7), Quarterback rating (DEN +1.4). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 45.0 total points (ARI 20, DEN 25). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.3), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 0.9), Natural grass field (lowers total 0.6). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
